item.title: Said & Checked, Disasters, Insurance and Risk, 2026-11-24: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Mike Kehoe)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Mike Kehoe, Governor of Missouri: “The states of Iowa, Missouri and Illinois do not have a say on when this is conducted.” Unsettled. AP reports that the Army chose the timing and that the 8th Circuit approved the EPA permit, and neither the EPA notice nor Iowa's fact sheet describes any approval role for Iowa, Missouri or Illinois. The permit text and the court order could not be read, and whether a state permit or order could bind the timing is a legal question no document read here decides.
